environment.description: AWS Lambda function triggered by S3 PUT events on the 'uploads/' prefix. The S3 bucket accepts uploads via a public-facing API Gateway endpoint with basic API key authentication. Any authenticated API consumer can upload ZIP files which are then processed by the Lambda. The processed output files are served directly from S3 via a public bucket policy on the 'processed/' prefix.

config.lambda_role: s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on entire bucket
